entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Finally, a person! I need to return this VeloBand GPS Tracker right now. Your website's return process is an absolute joke and it's not working.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely help you with a return. To get started, can I please have your name and order number?
The name is Michael Vance. Order number is VF78-99102. Look, I got this thing 24 days ago, and I want a full refund. This is ridiculous.

Thank you, Mr. Vance. I'm pulling up your order now... Yes, I see it here from December 15th. I understand you want to make a return. So I can document this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? Are you kidding me? My 'preference' was not to have a medical emergency! I'm in the military, and I bought this for an upcoming deployment, but I ended up in the hospital right after it was delivered. I needed immediate, unexpected surgery. I've been completely out of commission.
Oh my, Mr. Vance. I am so terribly sorry to hear that. I truly hope you're on the mend now. Please accept my apologies; that sounds incredibly difficult.

Spare me the apologies and just tell me if you're going to give me my money back. I am a VIP member, and I'm one step away from lighting you up on every review site and social media platform I can find. Do I need to speak to your manager?

There's no need for a manager, sir, I can absolutely handle this for you. Your situation is completely understandable. Let me just pull up our official return policy to confirm the details... one moment please.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed the policy, and I can confirm that all our items have a 90-day return window. Since you received your VeloBand just 24 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can process a full refund for you right now, no problem at all.
Oh. Ninety days? Seriously? Well... okay then. That's... actually a relief. Thank you.

Of course. And again, I am very sorry for the stressful time you've had. As you are one of our VIP members, and for the inconvenience this has caused, I'd also like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. It has no expiration date.
A $50 credit? Wow. Okay, that's very fair. I appreciate that, Sarah. Thank you for making this easy.

You're most welcome, Mr. Vance. I've just initiated the return and emailed you the pre-paid shipping label. It should be in your inbox within the next five minutes. Just print it, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks again.
It was my pleasure. I wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
